messages:
arjun: CedarHealth is reporting repeated 503s from their dedicated pool (ded-pool-47) after the quantized v2 rollout. Rollback attempt failed due to schema validation errors on the tokenizer. Need an owner and a short mitigation plan. sample error from the logs:
```ERROR 503 inference::serve - kv-cache mismatch -> tokenizer schema v1 vs v2; failing request_id=0x9f3a````
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2024-0721-83 for CedarHealth 503s (auto). Triage channel: #eng-oncall
maria: @arjun thanks — is this affecting all routes for the customer or just the high-llama route? Any chance we can route them to the fallback model (quantized v1) while infra investigates?
jia: I can look at the pool. Quick check: I see repeated OOMs around the same time as the deployment spike. If we can temporarily scale the pool +1 GPU and enable instance isolation for ded-pool-47 that might reduce failures while we fix the tokenizer mismatch. Need approval for burst capacity (will increase cost).
sam: I pushed a canary rollback command earlier. CLI to rollback to quantized v1 (safe):
```rwdctl deployments rollback --pool ded-pool-47 --to-tag quantized-v1 --force-canary```
However, the deploy failed because the schema check runs pre-start. If infra can toggle the schema gate or provide an override we can get traffic back on v1.
liam: Customer-impact: CedarHealth is seeing 40% request failures on peak workflows (claims ingestion). They're asking for ETA; they want partial mitigation ASAP. I can message them with a short ETA if we have one.
arjun: OK assigning owners: @sam for rollback path, @jia for pool scaling and schema-gate investigation. Please post an ETA within 30m. If rollback isn't possible, we'll route to fallback at the LB layer — @maria can you prep the LB policy?
maria: I can prepare LB rule: route cedarhealth/* -> quantized-v1-fallback with sticky-session disabled. Will need a short maintenance window note.
sam: Plan: try explicit schema-override flag with a dev image in the canary (10% traffic) and if stable for 5m, do full rollback. ETA for first canary attempt: +18m. If schema-override blocked, fallback to LB routing and ask infra to scale.
jia: Started scaling request now — provisioning +1 GPU to ded-pool-47. If scaling completes, I'll attempt schema gate logs and post results (ETA ~12m). If I hit blockers, I'll escalate to infra-ops.
liam: I'll tell CedarHealth: "We have owners on this and a tentative plan — expecting first mitigation (canary/scale) within ~20m. We'll update you as soon as the canary completes."
arjun: Great. Sam/Jia keep this thread updated with each milestone (canary started/ok/rollback done). If anyone opens a PR to patch tokenizer schema, paste PR link here for tracking (we'll tie to the incident).
sam: Will ping with PR/CR once I validate the canary. PR will likely be rwd/quantization#4123.
maria: LB rule drafted and tested in staging; ready to flip if needed. Leaving the maintenance note draft in #product-ops. :white_check_mark:
arjun: Thanks — marking owners and holding here. If no new updates in 30m I'll escalate to oncall lead.
